name: Reconstruction-based Generation
definition: A method that decomposes generation into two stages: multi-view generation followed by 3D reconstruction. A pre-trained multi-view or video diffusion model synthesizes posed views, which are then used as supervision for a GS reconstructor.
summary: Reconstruction-based Generation creates 3D models by first synthesizing multi-view images with diffusion models, then reconstructing 3D Gaussians from those images, distinguishing itself from direct prediction methods.
